Care & FAQ

Looking after it, and getting it to you.

Free shipping over $250, 30-day returns with the postage paid, and instructions for every piece.

Questions

The ones we get asked.

Care

One instruction per object.

  • Halo Pendant Dust with a dry cloth. Do not use solvents on the powder coat.
  • Arc Floor Lamp Wipe with a damp cloth. The base will patina at the edges; this is expected.
  • Cairn Side Table Re-oil once a year. Wipe spills promptly; oak marks with standing water.
  • Column Stool Re-oil once a year. Suitable for occasional outdoor use under cover.
  • Prism Vase Hand wash. Not dishwasher safe — the thermal shock will craze the faces.
  • Meridian Mirror Clean with glass cleaner on a cloth, never sprayed directly at the frame joint.
  • Quarry Bowl Dishwasher and oven safe to 200°C. Do not put on a direct flame.
  • Facet Carafe Hand wash. The cut lip will dull in a dishwasher.

Shipping & returns

The terms, in plain language.

Shipping. $18 standard, free over $250, and $35 for express — which is never free, because it genuinely costs us that. Furniture ships freight and takes seven to ten days on either option; we call to agree a window rather than assigning you one.

Tax. 8.5% is applied to goods and shipping, which is how most US states actually work. It is shown before you reach the last step, not after.

Returns. 30 days, unused, in the original packaging, and we pay the return postage. Brass and smoked oak are made to order and are excluded; both are marked as such on the product page and again at checkout.

Damage in transit. Photograph it before you unpack anything else and email us. We replace rather than repair, and we do not ask you to ship the broken one back first.

Trade. Architects, interior designers and hospitality projects get trade pricing. Email us the project and we will set up an account rather than make you fill in a portal.
